earliest_divergence.note: linear_z (attn_gate projection, Q4_K) is bit-identical from the same launch group, so the difference is specific to the Q6_K attn_qkv route, not to the shared input.

finding: With identical layer input (sha256 306c076e9d0adb2214074d7e27d85d7249da2e38fc44614bd776c0cffbda9c5f), identical layer-0 weights, identical all-zero initial conv/recurrent state and the same chain_compact_peer_wave32 GDN mode, the earliest differing operation between the resident TP1 bulk teacher and the TP2 bulk candidate is the Q6_K attn_qkv projection: linear_qkv (bf16 [64,10240]) differs by rel 3.73e-03 / max_abs 0.25 on a 67.0 peak, while the Q4_K attn_gate projection (linear_z, bf16 [64,6144]) from the same launch group is bit-identical. Both routes resolve the same GDN mode and the same launch sequence. Verified cause: MlpTP2GenerationSession.bulk_prefill calls the shared resident layer helpers directly, while Qwen35GGUFResidentSession wraps its whole bulk prefill in the session-scoped GGUF linear dispatch owners (q8_t16_two_wave_prefill_session, wmma_prefill_session, gemv_decode_session, q8_t16_dual_wmma_prefill_session, q4_pack8_dual_wmma_silu_prefill_session, q4_t16_unequal_pair_prefill_session, _prefill_f16_staging_context, _q6_integer_mmq_context, _iq_dense_mmq_context, _q8_mmq_prefill_context, _q6_f16_rocblas_prefill_context). Those context variables participate in launch_gguf_linear dispatch resolution and in its dispatch cache key, so the Q6_K projection resolves a different kernel on each route. Every downstream difference (conv_out 1.69e-03, prefill_query 6.99e-03, recurrent_bf16 1.51e-03, attn_out 6.98e-05) is consistent with this upstream difference. No production arithmetic was changed; the bulk route stays opt-in/default-off and no numerical threshold was relaxed.
limitations: Correctness diagnostic only: no performance claim.

attn_qkv/attn_gate weight bytes could not be hashed through layer.weight(name).allocation() (KeyError 'raw': those weights expose packed allocations under other names); the dispatch-context evidence does not depend on that hash.
One paired capture; no repeat run and no envelope run for the bulk route.
next_action: Give the TP2 bulk path the same session-scoped dispatch context per rank, then re-run this paired capture and confirm linear_qkv becomes bit-identical before any envelope claim.
